steps.domain_action: Select even integer n from the natural number stream
Hold n in the primary register to maintain numerical identity
Bifurcate n into a search space of integer pairs
Project the first candidate pair p and n-p
Confirm p is prime via trial division
Hold the potentiality of multiple valid prime pairs simultaneously
Subtract p from n to isolate the second candidate
Reject the pair if n-p is found to be composite
Increment to the next prime candidate in the sequence
Reconstitute the original integer n from the validated prime pair
Commit the partition p + q = n to the permanent mathematical record
Close the protocol for integer n
